g.text: MLM pseudo-perplexity — mask every position once (Salazar et al., 2020)
T forward passes for a T-token sentence — the masked copies are
batched into one tensor. With B = batch_size this is still T sequential
encoder calls per sentence; batch_size only chunks the
rescore_paths. Scoring an n-token beam of width k costs Θ(k · T) encoder passes.
Salazar et al. score only the
tokens; this implementation masks [CLS] and [SEP] too, so T counts them and
their near-deterministic (high) log-probabilities enter the mean, pulling PPPL
toward 1. They are 2 terms out of T, so the pull is //stronger for shorter
sentences//: PPPL here is not comparable to published numbers, and comparing
carries a length-dependent bias. Beams whose
candidates are all the same length are unaffected in
